FOREIGNER CELEBRATING 50 YEARS

Foreigner celebrates 50 years at OAKA Olympic Tennis Center in Athens on June 27, 2026. The legendary American-British rock band marks their golden anniversary with performance of classic hits.

Foreigner's catalog includes some of rock's most enduring anthems, from "I Want to Know What Love Is" to "Juke Box Hero" and "Hot Blooded." Fifty years of these songs represent remarkable achievement.

OAKA Olympic Tennis Center provides major venue scale for anniversary celebrations of this magnitude. The venue supports productions befitting Foreigner's legendary status.

This concert offers legendary classic rock celebrating a major milestone at one of Athens' largest venues.
